# StashStats

StashStats is a local analytics dashboard and inventory management platform for Ravelry yarn stash, project tracking, and fiber consumption analytics. Built with Python, Dash, Bootstrap, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Docker Compose.

## Core Capabilities

- **Stash Analytics & Distributions**: Analyzes yarn weight, fiber content, brand distribution, and yardage histograms across active inventory. See [[analytics-overview|Analytics Overview]].
- **Consumption Velocity**: Calculates stash burn-rate, rolling utilization, and lifespan horizons. See [[analytics-velocity|Consumption Velocity]].
- **Ravelry API Integration**: Synchronous client layer supporting multi-account authentication, automated pagination, and caching. See [[client-overview|Client Architecture]].
- **Interactive UI**: Dash web application featuring responsive dark-mode styling, live search filtering, and fast local caching. See [[web-app|Web Application]].

## Quick Start

```bash
# Clone and enter repo
git clone https://github.com/BeigePowerRanger/StashStats.git
cd StashStats

# Start core services with Docker Compose
docker compose up -d

# Run application locally with virtual environment
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
python app.py
```
